source.title: Stealthy Protocols: Metrics and Open Problems

trace.notes: Input normalized as a zbMATH resolver URL with identifier 6852761. The local resolver row in outputs/open-problems-0418-all.csv identified the exact work as Chen, Meadows, and Trivedi, "Stealthy Protocols: Metrics and Open Problems," with DOI 10.1007/978-3-319-51046-0_1. Direct shell fetching of https://zbmath.org/6852761 returned a Cloudflare challenge HTTP 403 response and later DNS resolution failures. zbMATH API/OAI recovery attempts against api.zbmath.org, oai.zbmath.org, and the purl.org/zb OAI route failed with DNS, certificate, or redirected-host fetch errors in this environment.

Failure mode: blocked_or_challenged plus paywalled_or_restricted/metadata_only. The DOI resolved to Springer chapter and book landing pages for the same exact work; these exposed the title, authors, abstract, references, DOI, pages 1-17, and purchase/login controls, but explicitly stated that the chapter/book content was preview or subscription content and did not expose the full technical body or complete open-problem statements. Bounded exact-work recovery searched the DOI, exact title plus PDF, exact title plus authors, DBLP key conf/birthday/ChenMT17, and exact-title bibliographic pages. DBLP, Grafiati, OpenAlex/local resolver rows, and citation pages were metadata only. A Studylib user-upload page appeared in search snippets with full-text-like content, but direct page fetching/opening did not yield a readable primary artifact in the available tools and it was not source-authorized. No questions were extracted from abstracts, metadata, or search snippets.
Saved final JSON to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-6852761.json and mirrored it to outputs/latest.json.
